note: Occupants of The Park's streets as printed in Wright's Directory of Nottingham, read out of the page-by-page OCR held by Leicester University's Historical Directories of England & Wales. Built 2026-09-14 by a script, not by hand. A directory records a householder a year or two after its survey and its OCR is imperfect: house numbers are kept only where legible or counted across from readable neighbours (marked inferred), and surnames can carry OCR damage. Evidence to weigh against a census household, never a filing on its own.
source: Wright's Directory of Nottingham, 1894-95, 1898-99, 1910-11, 1913-14 and 1915-16 — University of Leicester, Special Collections Online
